steps.title: Install Python 3.12
steps.detail: The sound tools run in their own Python environment. Unify installs Python 3.12 for you.

steps.title: Install Python 3.10 to 3.12
steps.detail: Install it with your package manager (for example: sudo apt install python3.12 python3.12-venv), then choose Run setup again below.

steps.title: Install ffmpeg
steps.detail: Needed to export .ogg and .mp3. Unify installs it for you.

steps.title: Build the sound tools
steps.detail: The install script sets up the sound libraries (numpy, scipy, pedalboard and friends). If this failed, check your internet connection and choose Run setup again below.

steps.title: Add a Freesound key (optional)
steps.detail: Lets agents search Freesound's free public-domain sounds. Open the Freesound page, sign in (a free account works), fill in the short form with any name and description, then copy the "Client secret/Api key" and paste it between the quotes after "freesoundToken" in the file below. Save the file; no restart needed.

steps.title: Add AI sound generation (optional)
steps.detail: About 5 GB, and much faster with an NVIDIA GPU. 1) Open the model page, sign in to Hugging Face and accept the licence. 2) Create a token with Read access at huggingface.co/settings/tokens and paste it between the quotes after "hfToken" in the file below. 3) Ask an agent: "run sound_setup with tier ai".
